name: context-window-manager
description: Graphical project-scoped context budgets and safe compaction profiles for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Graphical context slider and safe 1M profiles
interface.longDescription: Renders an interactive context-window slider, looks up exact model IDs in a bundled dated API catalog, and safely manages trusted-project Codex context and compaction settings. It does not detect or raise the effective ChatGPT/Codex host limit.
defaultPrompt: Open the graphical context-window slider for this project.
Use 1M only for an exact 1.05M API-catalog entry, and state the host-limit caveat.
